definitions.explanation: Having all necessary parts or elements; lacking nothing. Indicates a state without defects or deficiencies.
When used adverbially ({完全|かんぜん}に), expresses doing something thoroughly or to the fullest extent.

examples.japanese: {完全|かんぜん}な{形|かたち}で{残|のこ}っています。
{計画|けいかく}は{完全|かんぜん}に{失敗|しっぱい}しました。
{完全|かんぜん}な{答|こた}えはありません。

notes:
{完全|かんぜん} is a na-adjective meaning perfect or complete.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {完全|かんぜん}に (completely, perfectly)
- Noun modifier: {完全|かんぜん}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {完全|かんぜん}に{理解|りかい}する (understand completely)
- {完全|かんぜん}な{状態|じょうたい} (perfect condition)
- {完全|かんぜん}に{回復|かいふく}する (fully recover)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完璧|かんぺき}: flawless, impeccable (stronger emphasis on perfection)
- {全部|ぜんぶ}: all, everything (quantity-focused, not quality)
